Python.description: General-purpose programming language widely used in AI, ML, Web, and Automation.

Object-Oriented Programming.description: Design patterns, classes, inheritance, encapsulation, and modular code architecture.

Data Structures & Algorithms.description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, and algorithmic complexity (Big O).

SQL.description: Structured Query Language for querying, schema design, indexing, and data modeling.

Git & Version Control.description: Branching, merging, pull requests, commit hygiene, and collaborative version control.

NumPy.description: N-dimensional array operations, vectorized linear algebra, and mathematical computing.

Pandas.description: Data manipulation, DataFrame cleaning, aggregation, reshaping, and time-series handling.

Data Visualization.description: Exploratory data analysis using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Chart.js.

Applied Statistics.description: Probability distributions, hypothesis testing, p-values, regression, and Bayesian concepts.

Scikit-Learn.description: Classical machine learning algorithms: classification, regression, clustering, and cross-validation.

Machine Learning Modeling.description: Feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation (ROC, PR, F1), and model drift.

Deep Learning.description: Neural network architectures: feedforward, CNNs, RNNs, backpropagation, and loss functions.

PyTorch.description: Dynamic computation graphs, tensor operations, custom training loops, and PyTorch modules.

Natural Language Processing.description: Text tokenization, TF-IDF, embeddings, transformers, and sequence classification.

Computer Vision.description: Image processing, convolution, object detection, segmentation, and OpenCV.

Flask / FastAPI.description: RESTful API development, request handling, routing, serialization, and middleware.

Docker & Containerization.description: Building reproducible Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, container networking, and volumes.

MLOps & Model Deployment.description: Deploying models as microservices, pipeline monitoring, versioning, and CI/CD.

Cloud Computing (AWS/GCP/Azure).description: Cloud compute instances, object storage (S3), serverless functions, and managed databases.

HTML / CSS / JavaScript.description: Semantic markup, responsive UI layouts, DOM manipulation, and asynchronous HTTP calls.
